_about: Canonical brand names. 'aliases' maps every raw spelling seen in a source (CEC exports, old scrapes, spec sheets) to the canonical brand. 'stripModelPrefix' lists leading words to drop from a model name when its brand is normalised (e.g. 'Advanced Quiet Flo Variable QFVS2' -> 'Quiet Flo Variable QFVS2'). Used by tools/import-pumps.mjs and checked by tools/check-catalog.mjs.
